jobs.title: Fullstack Developer (Laravel & Vue)
jobs.description:
Ben jij de Fullstack Developer (Laravel \& Vue) die Emprover in Tilburg zoekt? Emprover gelooft in een krachtige én lerende publieke sector. Met hun slimme samenwerkingsplatform Emprover Ox en persoonlijke begeleiding helpen zij teams bij gemeenten, waterschappen en veiligheidsregio's om strategisch en resultaatgericht samen te werken. Hun ontwikkelteam in Tilburg groeit en daarvoor zijn wij op zoek naar een fullstack ontwikkelaar die zich net zo thuis voelt in de front\-end (Vue) als de back\-end (Laravel), en die vooral ook wil meebouwen aan een hecht team in een creatieve, winnende SaaS propositie


**Wat ga je doen?**


* Je werkt zowel aan de front\-end (Vue) als de back\-end (Laravel) van het platform en schakelt daar moeiteloos tussen.
* Je denkt actief mee over de techniek achter Emprover Ox en bouwt mee aan integraties met API's die het werk van gemeenten écht makkelijker maken.
* Je bouwt mee aan de volgende stap van Emprover: een eigen lokale AI\-engine (LLM), die gekoppeld wordt aan het Ox\-platform om de publieke sector nog een stukje sterker te maken.
* Je bent een verbindende factor in het team en bouwt actief mee aan een groeiend bedrijf en een sterk, hecht team waarin collega's elkaar vooruithelpen.
  
**Wat breng je mee?**


* Ervaring met zowel Laravel (PHP) als Vue
* Je hebt al een paar jaar ervaring en zelfvertrouwen opgebouwd, maar wilt nog volop groeien
* Je bent een verbinder: sociaal, communicatief en oprecht geïnteresseerd in je collega's en klanten
* Je vertaalt technische zaken makkelijk naar begrijpelijke taal voor niet\-technische mensen
* Je hebt interesse in AI/LLM\-ontwikkeling en vindt het leuk om daarin mee te bouwen
* Je kiest bewust voor een klein team en denkt in een langetermijnsamenwerking
* Je bent 40 uur per week beschikbaar en werkt vanuit het kantoor van Emprover in Tilburg (bij Centraal Station); deels thuiswerken is bespreekbaar
**Wat bieden wij jou?**


* Een salaris tussen de €4\.000 en €5\.000 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring
* Een informele, hechte werkomgeving met een klein team waarin iedereen ertoe doet
* Laptop naar keuze
* Reiskostenvergoeding / OV\-vergoeding, want Emprover is gevestigd in de bruisende Spoorzone, naast Tilburg Centraal Station!
* Elke vrijdag samen lunchen en regelmatig gezellige teamdagen
* Ruimte voor eigen inbreng in hoe het product en team verder gebouwd worden
* De kans om mee te bouwen aan een eigen AI\-engine (lokale LLM) en Ox Academie

Wil jij ons team versterken? Bel of mail ons gerust — we horen graag van je!

jobs.title: Mendix Developer
jobs.description:
Zin in een rol waarin je veel vrijheid krijgt om je eigen keuzes te maken, maar waar er altijd collega's klaar staan om mee te sparren? Bij BlueTale krijg je de ruimte om Mendix\-oplossingen te bouwen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen \- of dat nu vanaf nul is bij een nieuwe klant, of door verder te bouwen op wat er al staat.

Geen micromanagement, maar wel klanten die op je vertrouwen, collega's die graag met je meedenken en genoeg ruimte om steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te pakken in techniek, aanpak en architectuur.

**Wat ga je doen?**

Je gaat aan de slag bij uiteenlopende organisaties. Soms bouw je compleet nieuwe Mendix\-oplossingen voor een klant die net begint, en soms werk je verder aan een bestaande applicatie en help je die naar een hoger niveau.

Die afwisseling houdt het interessant: het ene moment sta je aan de basis van een nieuw systeem, het andere moment verbeter je wat er al staat. Je denkt mee over technische keuzes en architectuur, werkt samen met klanten en collega's en krijgt de ruimte om steeds meer eigenaarschap te nemen.

Afhankelijk van je ervaring doe je dat zelfstandig of samen met een ervaren collega.

* Nieuwe Mendix\-oplossingen bouwen bij klanten
* Meedenken over de architectuur en technische inrichting van applicaties
* Businessvraagstukken vertalen naar slimme en toekomstbestendige oplossingen
* Bestaande Mendix\-oplossingen doorontwikkelen en optimaliseren
* Integraties bouwen met bestaande IT\-systemen
* Klanten helpen met vraagstukken rondom best practices, governance en performance
* Sparren met collega's en samen zoeken naar de beste oplossing
* Jezelf verder ontwikkelen op het gebied van Mendix, consultancy en architectuur

**Wie ben jij?**

Je bent een Mendix Developer of Consultant die graag verantwoordelijkheid pakt en verder wil groeien. Je hoeft nog niet alles gezien of gedaan te hebben. Belangrijker vinden we dat je een goede technische basis hebt, nieuwsgierig bent en graag nadenkt over hoe dingen beter kunnen.

Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar weet ook wanneer het slim is om een collega erbij te betrekken. En krijg je meer verantwoordelijkheid? Dan vind je het leuk om die ook daadwerkelijk te pakken.

Natuurlijk kijken we naar wat je kunt, maar minstens zo belangrijk vinden we wie je bent. We werken in een klein team en vinden het belangrijk dat er een goede klik is. Dat betekent voor ons: jezelf kunnen zijn, plezier hebben in wat je doet, samen kunnen lachen en elkaar helpen als dat nodig is. Want goed werk leveren is belangrijk, maar met plezier naar je werk gaan minstens zo.

* Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen van Mendix\-applicaties
* Je hebt bij voorkeur een Mendix\-certificering, of bent bereid die verder uit te bouwen
* Je hebt ervaring met of interesse in integraties, architectuur en performance
* Je vindt het leuk om met klanten samen te werken en hun vraag achter de vraag te begrijpen
* Je neemt initiatief en durft technische keuzes te maken
* Je wilt jezelf verder ontwikkelen als Mendix Developer en/of Consultant
* Je hebt een afgeronde hbo\- of wo\-opleiding
* Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en beheerst Engels goed
* Je woont in Nederland

**Wat bieden wij jou?**

Bij BlueTale draait het niet om afvinklijstjes, maar om mensen die willen groeien en zelf sturing willen geven aan hun werk. Hoe meer je kunt en wilt oppakken, hoe meer ruimte je daarvoor krijgt.

* Een goed salaris, 13e maand en uitstekende pensioenregeling
* 30 vakantiedagen
* Auto van de zaak of een aantrekkelijk mobiliteitsbudget
* Laptop, telefoon en thuiswerkvergoeding
* Veel vrijheid in hybride werken \- werk waar jij het beste presteert
* Een persoonlijk opleidingsbudget, zodat jij bepaalt hoe je groeit
* Uitdagende projecten bij toonaangevende klanten
* Ervaren collega's om mee te sparren en van te leren
* Een informeel team met korte lijnen, veel humor en weinig hiërarchie

**Klaar om je eigen koers te bepalen?**

Wil je meer dan alleen uitvoeren en zoek je een plek waar je kunt groeien in verantwoordelijkheid? Bij ons bouw je mee aan de toekomst van low\-code.

Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar voel je wel die klik? Heb je een goede basis in Mendix, ben je nieuwsgierig en wil je graag verder groeien? Neem contact op. We horen graag van je!

Soort dienstverband: Fulltime, Parttime, Vaste baan

Salaris: €4\.000,00 \- €6\.750,00 per maand

* Auto van de zaak

* Kerstpakket

* Pensioen
* Reiskostenvergoeding
* Telefoonplan

BAE Systems Digital Intelligence is home to 4,500 digital, cyber and intelligence experts. We work collaboratively across 10 countries to collect, connect and understand complex data, so that governments, nation states, armed forces and commercial businesses can unlock digital advantage in the most demanding environments.

  

**Job Title: Senior C\+\+ Software Engineer**
  

**Location: Gloucester**
  

These roles require 5 days/ week on site. We offer a range of flexible working arrangements – please speak to your recruiter about the options for this particular role.
  

  

**Who we are**
  

Join BAE Systems and you’ll be part of something bigger. As a valued member of our global colleague network, you’ll bring your unique skills and perspectives to help pioneer progress and protect what matters most. You’ll be trusted to play your part in delivering the advanced, technology\-led defence, aerospace and security solutions of tomorrow – shaping a safer future, for all of us.
  

From the depths of the ocean, to the far reaches of space – there’s no limit to where a career at BAE Systems could take you.
  

  

**Role description**
  

We are looking for experienced Software Engineers who want to have a real impact, and who are keen to apply their creative thinking to the ever\-changing space of cybersecurity.

  

**Core duties**


* Technical delivery: understand and use various development methodologies to deliver solutions to our customers, factoring in operational security into system design, development, and testing.
* Mentorship, team\-leadership, and collaboration: work in teams to deliver high\-assurance code, conducting constructive peer review, and knowledge sharing with junior team\-members.
* Implementing robust solutions: design, develop, test, and document software in accordance with business \& industry best practices, to meet our customer requirements, leveraging continuous integration where appropriate.
* Adaptability: embrace emerging technology, tools, and language trends, while identifying the risks that they could present.
* Security mindset: be capable of identifying flaws during solution design and implementation, along with mitigations.
  

**What we’re looking for**:


* Familiarity with a variety of development tools (IDEs, debuggers, source control) and techniques (unit testing, mocking, continuous integration, test\-driven development).
* Knowledge of the principles of high\-assurance development, and an awareness of the importance of IT security for companies and governments.
* Intermediate to advanced understanding of computing principles (e.g. stack/heap distinction, compiled/interpreted languages).
* Proficiency with at least one solution language (e.g. C\+\+, Java, C\#) and one utility language (e.g. Python, JavaScript, Perl, PowerShell).
* Ability to use and configure more than one major operating system.
* Ability to pick up new languages and technologies easily.
* Ability to communicate regarding technical topics to a variety of audiences, including non\-technical.
* Experience of mentoring others and/or leading technical tasks.
  

**The team**
  

Operational Cyber Group is a team of industry\-leading experts in high\-assurance development, research, reverse engineering, and vulnerability research.With a focus on National Security, we work on some of the country’s toughest challenges. Our people provide mission\-changing capability for our customers across a wide variety of platforms and technologies.

  

  

**Why BAE Systems?**
  

Here you’ll build a career with purpose and limitless possibilities. With lifelong learning and meaningful work – this is a place where you can grow your career with confidence and be empowered to be your best. You’ll be recognised for your contribution and enjoy rewards tailored to what’s most important to you and your family – support for your financial and personal wellbeing, as well as a balanced lifestyle. In an environment embracing sustainable ways of working and with a strong sense of shared purpose, our supportive culture is a place you can feel you belong and proud of the difference you make.
  

A place where everyone can thrive.
  

We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. We know that a diversity of backgrounds, perspectives and experiences strengthens our teams and is vital to the work we do.
  

We welcome applications from all candidates and give full, fair and open consideration to everyone. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team to discuss any further support you may need.

  

  

**Security statement**
  

Please be aware that many roles at BAE Systems are subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors such as your nationality, any nationalities you may have previously held, and your place of birth can restrict the roles you are eligible to perform within the organisation. All applicants must as a minimum achieve Baseline Personnel Security Standard. Many roles also require higher levels of National Security Vetting where applicants must typically have 5 to 10 years of continuous residency in the UK depending on the vetting level required for the role, to allow for meaningful security vetting checks.
  

Applicants for these particular roles will need to be able to successfully achieve an eDV UK security clearance. For more details see https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united\-kingdom\-security\-vetting\-clearance\-levels/dv\-guidance\-pack\-for\-applicants

  

**Life at BAE Systems Digital Intelligence**


We are embracing Hybrid Working. This means you and your colleagues may be working in different locations, such as from home, another BAE Systems office or client site, some or all of the time, and work might be going on at different times of the day.


By embracing technology, we can interact, collaborate and create together, even when we’re working remotely from one another. Hybrid Working allows for increased flexibility in when and where we work, helping us to balance our work and personal life more effectively, and enhance well\-being.


Diversity and inclusion are integral to the success of BAE Systems Digital Intelligence. We are proud to have an organisational culture where employees with varying perspectives, skills, life experiences and backgrounds – the best and brightest minds – can work together to achieve excellence and realise individual and organisational potential.


**Division overview: Capabilities**


At BAE Systems Digital Intelligence, we pride ourselves in being a leader in the cyber defence industry, and Capabilities is the engine that keeps the business moving forward. It is the largest area of Digital Intelligence, containing our Engineering, Consulting and Project Management teams that design and implement the defence solutions and digital transformation projects that make us a globally recognised brand in both the public and private sector.


As a member of the Capabilities team, you will be creating and managing the solutions that earn us our place in an ever changing digital world. We all have a role to play in defending our clients, and this is yours.

Application platform destinations
You are fluent across the full Azure application platform and can articulate — with credibility, in front of architects — when to choose each:* Azure App Service — for web apps and APIs that benefit from a fully managed PaaS runtime with minimal operational overhead; the fastest path off Windows/IIS and Java/Tomcat estates.

You build the platform itself, not the screens in front of it. Your working level is domain models, APIs, messages and data: what a service owns, what its contract promises, which events it publishes, and how its data is shaped so that it still answers the questions we will ask of it in three years. You work in an agile team of 14 people with developers, architects, test engineers and product owner, shaping design decisions rather than only implementing them.

The work here is engineering, not configuration. We build on . NET 10
and C#, with PostgreSQL
for domain data, Apache Kafka
for events, Redis
for caching and ClickHouse
for high-volume telemetry. Services are containerised and run on Kubernetes, brought up locally with .NET Aspire and tested against real dependencies with Testcontainers, shipped through Azure DevOps pipelines and instrumented with OpenTelemetry
.

We are building a new back-end, designed around domain-driven design rather than carried over from what came before. The interesting questions are still open: where the domain boundaries lie, what each service owns, which events carry the truth. You get to answer them, on a fleet that is already global and still growing.

In This Role, You Will

Design and build domain services: bounded contexts, aggregates and a language the business recognises, in cloud-native .NET services that own their own data.
Own your API contracts: design APIs that others build on, version them deliberately, and treat breaking a consumer as a decision rather than an accident.
Design events, not just messages: Avro schemas in a registry, schema evolution, idempotency and replay, and a clear answer for the message that cannot be processed.
Model data for the questions it will be asked: relational design in PostgreSQL where the structure is known, JSONB where it has to stay flexible, and query patterns that still hold when the fleet doubles.
Engineer for fleet scale: hundreds of thousands of devices reporting continuously, where an unbounded consumer or a missing index is not a slow page but an outage.
Make your services observable and operable: OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs, health checks, and alerts worth being woken up for.
Test your own work, with unit and integration tests next to the product code against containerised dependencies rather than mocks, alongside the test engineers who build our shared framework.

jobs.title: Customer Solutions Engineer (Full Stack / Java)
jobs.description:
ABOUT CARAVELO

Airlines have spent decades selling one trip at a time. At Caravelo, we help them build recurring relationships with their customers instead.

We build the technology behind airline subscription products used by carriers around the world, combining SaaS, payments, booking systems and airline integrations in one platform.

Our Product & Platform teams build the common technology. Our Professional Services team makes it work in the real world for each airline.

That is where this role comes in.

THE MISSION

Caravelo has one platform, but no two airline implementations are exactly the same.

As a Customer Solutions Engineer in our Professional Services team
, your job is to bridge that gap.

You will learn how our core platform can be configured, integrated and extended, and use those capabilities to create the implementation each customer needs — without modifying or forking the core platform.

For every airline, we build a customer plugin
that wraps the specific integrations, extensions, business rules and behaviours required to make Caravelo fit naturally into that customer's technology landscape.

Working closely with Project Managers and customer stakeholders, you will understand requirements, identify the peculiarities of each implementation and decide how best to solve them: configuration, extension, integration or, when justified, a dedicated service or module.

The goal is simple:

Make every customer rollout feel unique while keeping it cleanly built on top of a common, scalable platform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Bring customers live

You will be one of the engineers turning a signed customer into a working production implementation.

That means:
Understand customer requirements together with the Project Manager.
Translate business and technical requirements into a concrete implementation.
Configure and extend the Caravelo platform using the capabilities provided by our Product & Platform teams.
Build and maintain the customer plugin that contains customer-specific logic and integrations.
Take implementations through development, testing, launch and production stabilisation.

You'll work closely with our Platform and Product engineers, who will provide the documentation, tooling and training needed to understand the core platform and its extension points.

Your job is not to rebuild what already exists. It is to understand the platform deeply enough to use it intelligently and extend it where necessary.

Solve integration problems

Airlines have complex technology ecosystems.

Some systems are modern. Others have been running successfully for decades.

You will make them work together.

Depending on the customer, you may integrate Caravelo with:
Airline reservation and passenger service systems.
Payment gateways and payment infrastructure.
Identity and authentication platforms.
CRM and communication systems.
Loyalty platforms.
Data platforms.
Internal airline APIs.
Third-party and legacy systems.

Sometimes the solution will be straightforward.

Sometimes the API documentation will be incomplete, the behaviour will differ between environments, or two systems will have fundamentally different assumptions.

You should enjoy figuring those problems out.

Build customer-specific extensions

Most customer needs should be solved using the common platform.

But not all of them will be.

When there is a genuine gap, you may:
Build an additional connector.
Extend an existing workflow.
Create customer-specific business logic.
Develop an isolated service or module.
Implement data transformation or migration processes.

The challenge is knowing when to configure, when to extend and when to build something new.

We want engineers who can solve the customer problem without creating unnecessary complexity.

Own the implementation beyond go-live

Our work does not stop when a customer launches.

Customer systems evolve, vendors change and integrations eventually need to move with them.

You will help:
Investigate and debug production issues.
Maintain customer-specific integrations.
Upgrade connectors as external systems evolve.
Support customers through technical migrations.
Replace or introduce integrations while keeping the service running.
Improve existing implementations when better platform capabilities become available.

For example, an airline may decide to replace its payment gateway.

Your work could involve enabling the new payment connector in Caravelo, adapting the customer plugin, helping define the migration approach for existing payment tokens, validating the transition and supporting the rollout together with the Project Manager and customer team.

These are not theoretical architecture exercises. They are real production systems with real customers behind them.

Work across the stack when needed

Your centre of gravity will be Java and backend engineering.

But customer implementations do not always respect stack boundaries.

You should be comfortable following a feature or problem wherever it goes: backend services, APIs, integrations, databases, scripts, data migrations or occasional frontend changes in Vue.

You do not need to be a frontend specialist.

You do need to be comfortable enough to understand the problem, use AI-assisted development effectively and validate that the result is production-quality.

Use AI as an engineering tool

We actively use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and similar assistants.

You will use them for things like:
Implementation.
Exploring unfamiliar code.
Writing and extending tests.
Debugging.
Refactoring.
Documentation.
Working with APIs and integrations.
Accelerating occasional frontend work.

We are particularly interested in Spec-Driven Development: defining clearly what needs to be built before asking AI to help implement it.

AI should make you faster. It should not replace engineering judgment.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

You are succeeding in this role when:
You can take a customer requirement and turn it into a clean, production-ready solution.
Customers launch successfully without unnecessary changes to the core platform.
Customer-specific behaviour remains well isolated and maintainable.
Integrations are observable, reliable and understandable by engineers other than their original author.
You can diagnose complex problems across Caravelo and customer systems.
You understand when to configure the platform, when to extend it and when custom development is genuinely necessary.
You become increasingly independent in understanding new customer technology landscapes.
Migrations and changes to existing integrations can be delivered without destabilising the customer's service.

WHAT YOU BRING

Must have:

Strong professional experience building production software in Java, with solid backend engineering fundamentals.
Experience designing and integrating APIs, distributed services and cloud-based systems.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, especially when working across multiple systems or external dependencies.
Good understanding of testing, CI/CD, databases, observability and production software quality.
Comfortable understanding an existing platform and extending it cleanly rather than rebuilding from scratch.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work with Project Managers, engineers and technical customer stakeholders.

Nice to have:
Experience in Professional Services, implementation engineering, solutions engineering or customer-facing technical delivery.
Experience integrating enterprise or legacy systems, particularly in complex customer environments.
Experience with payments, payment gateways, data migrations or other business-critical integrations.
Experience in travel technology, airlines, reservation systems or similarly integration-heavy industries.
Familiarity with the technologies listed in our stack, especially Vue/Nuxt, Couchbase or Datadog.
Experience working in security-, compliance- or reliability-sensitive environments.

OUR STACK

You do not need to arrive knowing every technology we use.

Some of the technologies you may encounter include:

Java · SpringBoot · Vue.js · Nuxt · Couchbase · PostgreSQL · AWS · Datadog · Gitlab · Docker · Opentofu · Claude Code · Cursor

More important than matching every technology is your ability to understand unfamiliar systems, investigate how things work and build reliable solutions around them.

THE KIND OF ENGINEER WHO TENDS TO ENJOY THIS ROLE

This role may be a good fit if you like engineering problems where the answer is not always obvious.

You enjoy understanding how systems behave, not just implementing predefined tickets.

You are comfortable opening documentation for an unfamiliar API, talking through requirements with a Project Manager, tracing a strange production issue across several systems and then writing the code that solves it.

You appreciate good architecture, but you are pragmatic.

And when confronted with a 15-year-old airline system that behaves differently from its documentation, your reaction is closer to “interesting” than “that's someone else's problem.”

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive salary with a clear progression framework.
Flexible working hours.
Barcelona-based hybrid model: 4 days in the office and 1 day working from home.
Tax-efficient benefits including private health insurance, restaurant and transport cards, and kindergarten support.
Budget for training and conferences.
Regular company events and celebrations.
23 days of annual leave.
Exposure to complex airline technology environments around the world.
The opportunity to work across software engineering, integrations and real customer implementations.
Meaningful ownership: you will see the systems you build go from requirements to production.

INTERESTED?

If you enjoy solving complex integration problems, getting customers live and making different systems work together without turning every implementation into a one-off project, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply and tell us about a difficult integration, migration or production problem you've solved.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

In this role, you will design and build next-generation applications powered by AI agents on the Microsoft Azure ecosystem. You'll own features end-to-end, from responsive front-end experiences to scalable back-end services and agent orchestration layers, building applications for, driven by, and consumed by AI agents - combining strong full stack fundamentals with cutting-edge agentic AI development.

Please note that this is a hybrid role, requiring office attendance at least twice a week.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and build full stack, production-grade applications based on AI agents and multi-agent architectures.
Develop modern, responsive web UIs supporting conversational experiences, real-time streaming agent responses, and dashboards for monitoring agents.
Build robust back-end services and APIs (REST, gRPC, MCP) in Python (FastAPI), enabling agent-to-agent and agent-to-system communication.
Develop agentic workflows using frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LangChain/LangGraph, or Azure AI Agent Service.
Integrate LLMs via Azure OpenAI Service, including prompt engineering, function/tool calling, and RAG pipelines.
Design chunking and indexing strategies for RAG pipelines (semantic chunking, hybrid search, re-ranking) to optimize retrieval quality.
Build and maintain evaluation pipelines for LLM/agent outputs (e.g., RAGAS, promptfoo, or custom eval frameworks) to measure accuracy, relevance, and reliability.
Design cloud-native solutions using Azure Functions, AKS, Container Apps, Cosmos DB, and Azure AI Search, including data models across SQL and NoSQL stores.
Implement secure, observable, cost-optimized systems using Azure Monitor, Key Vault, Entra ID, and CI/CD pipelines with infrastructure-as-code.

REQUIREMENTS

8+ years of full stack engineering experience, with at least 3 years on the Azure stack.
Strong back-end skills in Python, with a solid grasp of distributed systems and microservices.
Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs and agent frameworks (Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LangGraph, or similar).
Strong front-end proficiency in modern frameworks, typed JavaScript, semantic HTML/CSS, and responsive, accessible UI design.
Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and vector databases (Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB vector search).
Proven experience with RAG architectures, embeddings, chunking/indexing strategies, prompt orchestration, and tool/function calling.
Hands-on experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM/agent outputs and defining quality metrics for AI systems.
Experience designing end-to-end agentic solution architectures (multi-agent orchestration, tool/agent boundaries, error-handling and fallback strategies).
Experience building real-time features (WebSockets, SignalR, SSE) for streaming AI/agent responses.
Solid understanding of authentication/authorization (OAuth2, Entra ID) and DevOps practices (CI/CD, IaC, Docker/Kubernetes).
